findings.issue: «votó … voto» is the ballot collocation. Qal H5087 and noun H5088 license vowing a vow; current Spanish votar does not say that.
«haré anatema» may narrow hiphil H2763 (ban, devote to destruction) to curse or excommunication.

notes: Israel, Jehová, 2ms das, 1cs haré, en mi mano, and sus ciudades match the tokens.
